name: Sub-interval Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) Combination
definition: A method to compute full-interval radiance and optical depth by splitting the interval at an intermediate point D, allowing smoke and fire to be drawn one mesh at a time or combining RTE solutions from multiple slice planes.
summary: Sub-interval RTE Combination renders participating media by solving the radiative transfer equation for discrete 2D slices and combining them via hardware compositing, differing from standard methods by processing data in discrete slices rather than continuous ray integrals.
